title: 第7章 九星连珠尸变第8章 凤舞大陆灵汐
slug: 圣殇天狱第1013章力战古神
content_zh:
美姑西山，
荒凉中带着萧瑟，
这里是万年坟场，
隔着眉河流域与葬天丛林遥遥对望！
艳阳在这里变成了白日，
夏天到这里都感觉冷风嗖嗖，汗毛倒竖。
满眼沧桑中，
大坟，小坟，古坟，新坟，石坟，土坟，乱葬岗···
有的高大耸立万年，
有的就是一杯黄土。
有的幽黑阴森，
有的花花绿绿。
一声声通幽黑鸦悠长的嘶叫在坟山哀鸣，
天空经常乌云密布，
时常阴风阵阵，
那些不知道经历了多少风吹雨淋的黄白经幡在阴风中飘来荡去，
灰白的芦苇花到处飘，
不知道在昭示何物！
夜晚，漆黑如墨，冷月如勾，
坟场传来一声声幽怨哀嚎，

让人毛骨竦然！
忽然，
幽黑的天空那轮冷月被厚厚的乌云彻底遮盖，
所有星光被黑气乌云淹没，
大地一片漆黑，
连风都禁止了。
只听见乱葬岗那条小沟沟的黄水，汩汩流动的声音，
让人毛骨悚然，
全是死尸的坟山，沟沟里的黄水来自何处，
这是个迷！
乱葬岗一处低洼处，
黄水在这里缓冲，形成一个三丈多的小水荡。
小水荡中有具浮尸，已经在这里九九八十一天发萢，
虽然身死，
口眼大张，死不瞑目，
浮肿的额头乌黑，有天大的怨气，怨气天长日久变成；煞气！
一身大红衣服破破烂烂，
身上数不清的刀枪棍棒伤口，
一只手被刀砍断剩下一根肉筋吊着，
脖子上被一剑割喉，

脑袋有被铁钉重击后的洞窟，
死相惨不忍睹。
content_en:
Meigu Xishan,
There is desolation in the desolation,
This is the Ten Thousand Years Cemetery,
Looking across the Meihe River Basin and Zangtian Jungle from afar!
The bright sun turns into day here,
Even here in the summer, you feel the cold wind whistling and your hair standing on end.
Eyes full of vicissitudes of life,
Large grave, small grave, ancient grave, new grave, stone grave, earth grave, mass grave...
Some have stood tall for thousands of years,
Some are just a cup of loess.
Some are dark and gloomy,
Some are colorful.
A long and long cry of dark crows wailed in the graveyard,
The sky is often covered with clouds,
The wind is often blowing,
Those yellow and white prayer flags that have experienced countless winds and rains are floating back and forth in the dark wind.
Gray reed flowers are floating everywhere,
I don’t know what it is indicating!
The night is as dark as ink and the cold moon is like a hook,
There were moans and groans from the cemetery,
It makes people feel terrified!
suddenly,
The cold moon in the dark sky was completely covered by thick dark clouds,
All the starlight is drowned by the dark clouds,
The earth is dark,
Even the wind is forbidden.
I could only hear the gurgling sound of the yellow water in the small ditch in the mass grave.
It's creepy,
Tombs full of dead bodies, where does the yellow water in the ditches come from?
This is a mystery!
A low-lying spot in a mass grave,
The yellow water buffers here, forming a small pool of more than three feet.
There is a floating corpse in the small pond. It has been here for ninety-nine and eighty-one days.
Although dead,
His mouth and eyes are wide open, and he will not close his eyes until death.
The swollen forehead is black, and there is great resentment. Over time, the resentment turns into evil spirit!
A bright red dress in tatters,
He has countless wounds from swords, guns and sticks,
One hand was cut off by a knife, leaving a tendon hanging.
His throat was cut with a sword,
There are holes in the head after being hit hard by iron nails,
The death was horrific.
